sections.title: About Empório da Música
sections.text:
1. About Empório da Música
Empório da Música is a specialist musical instrument store founded in 2008 in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. With more than 15 years in business, it is a regional reference for beginner, intermediate and professional musicians.
The manual describes a catalog of more than 300 instruments from Brazilian and international brands, including electric guitars, basses, acoustic guitars, drums, keyboards, wind instruments, orchestral strings and ukuleles.
We sell musical instruments exclusively. We do not sell accessories such as strings, picks, cables, cases, pedals or amplifiers.
1.1 Mission
Make quality musical instruments accessible in Brazil's Central-West region, offering specialist service and competitive prices while contributing to the community's cultural and musical development.
1.2 Company Details

sections.title: Opening Hours
sections.text:
2. Opening Hours
In-store service follows the hours below. WhatsApp service follows the same schedule, with automated replies outside business hours.
Monday to Friday: 09:00 to 18:00
Saturday: 09:00 to 13:00
Sundays and public holidays: Closed
Hours may be extended for special occasions such as Black Friday, the store anniversary and Christmas. Changes will be announced in advance on social media and through WhatsApp support.

sections.title: Payment Methods
sections.text:
3. Payment Methods
The following methods are accepted for in-store and online purchases:
PIX: Immediate payment; 5% discount on the list price.
Debit card: Immediate payment; all card networks accepted.
Credit card: Up to 12 interest-free installments; minimum installment BRL 100.00.
Bank payment slip (boleto): Single payment; clearing can take up to 3 business days.
3.1 Installment Rules
Up to 3 installments: interest-free, with no minimum installment amount (except below BRL 50.00).
4 to 6 installments: interest-free, minimum installment BRL 80.00.
7 to 12 installments: interest-free, minimum installment BRL 100.00.
Combining payment methods, such as PIX and card, is allowed for purchases above BRL 2,000.00.

sections.title: Exchanges and Returns
sections.text:
4. Exchanges and Returns
Empório da Música follows the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code (Law 8.078/90) and provides clear exchange and return conditions.
4.1 Right of Withdrawal for Online Purchases
Customers may request a return within 7 calendar days after receiving the product, without providing a reason.
The product must be in its original packaging, show no signs of use and include all accessories and manuals.
Refunds use the original payment method and are processed within 10 business days.
The store pays return shipping for withdrawal returns.
4.2 Exchanges for Defects
Products with manufacturing defects may be exchanged within 30 calendar days after purchase.
After those 30 days, the customer must contact the manufacturer directly for warranty service. The store can assist with that process on request.
Damage caused by misuse, falls, excessive humidity or unauthorized modifications is not covered.
4.3 Exchanges Based on Preference
Exchanges for a different color, model or size are allowed within 7 days, subject to availability of the desired product.
The product must be in perfect condition and in its original packaging.
Price differences will be charged or refunded as applicable.
4.4 Items Not Eligible for Exchange
Instruments with customization or made-to-order adjustments, including setup or special regulation.
Clearance products explicitly marked as final sale.
Wind instrument mouthpieces, for hygiene reasons.

sections.title: Shipping and Delivery
sections.text:
5. Shipping and Delivery
5.1 Delivery in the Campo Grande Metropolitan Area
Free shipping for orders above BRL 500.00.
Orders below BRL 500.00 have a fixed BRL 35.00 shipping fee.
Delivery time: 1 to 3 business days.
Delivery is handled by the store's own motorcycle courier. The customer will be contacted by phone before delivery.
5.2 Delivery to Other Cities
We use Correios PAC and SEDEX, and the Jadlog carrier, outside the Campo Grande metropolitan area.
PAC (Correios): estimated 5 to 12 business days; tracking available; insurance included.
SEDEX (Correios): estimated 2 to 5 business days; tracking available; insurance included.
Jadlog (.package): estimated 3 to 8 business days; tracking available; insurance included.
Shipping cost is calculated automatically from the destination postal code, product weight and dimensions. Large instruments such as acoustic drum kits, digital pianos and double basses may require an individual shipping quote.
All shipments include insurance against loss and transit damage. If a shipment is damaged, the customer should refuse delivery and contact the store immediately.
5.3 Tracking Code
The tracking code is sent automatically by email and WhatsApp when the order is dispatched.
The standard format is BR followed by 9 alphanumeric characters and BR, for example BR4K7M2X9P1BR.
Tracking can be checked directly on the Correios or Jadlog website.

sections.title: Promotions and Discounts
sections.text:
6. Promotions and Discounts
6.1 Promotion Types
The store runs periodic campaigns throughout the year:
Store anniversary in August: 10% to 25% off selected items.
Black Friday in November: 15% to 30% off the catalog.
Back to school in February: special offers on student instruments.
Stock clearance: occasional promotions to renew the catalog.
Musician's Week: promotions during the week of Musician's Day, November 22.
6.2 Promotion Rules
Stacking: promotions cannot be combined. The 5% PIX discount does not apply to already-discounted promotional prices.
Stock: promotions depend on stock availability. Products that sell out during a promotion do not qualify for a rain check or reserved promotional price.
Communication: promotional prices must always be shown alongside the original price and discount percentage for transparency.

sections.title: WhatsApp Customer Support
sections.text:
7. WhatsApp Customer Support
WhatsApp at (67) 3321-4500 is the main remote support channel. Service may be provided by human staff or the virtual assistant.
7.1 Service Guidelines
Tone: informal but professional. Customers should feel welcome, as if talking to a friend who understands music. Avoid excessively formal or robotic language.
Response time: at most 5 minutes during business hours. Outside those hours, the virtual assistant must state when service resumes.
Accuracy: never provide prices, stock availability or delivery estimates without consulting the system. Incorrect information frustrates customers and may constitute misleading advertising.
Scope: explain that the store sells musical instruments exclusively. Requests for accessories such as strings, cables, picks, pedals, amplifiers or cases should be politely redirected. Suggest partner stores when possible.
7.2 Standard Service Flow
1. Greeting: greet the customer by name when available and ask how you can help.
2. Understanding: identify whether the customer needs a product, information, tracking or help with a complaint.
3. Lookup: query the system for relevant product, stock, promotion or order information.
4. Response: present options clearly, with prices and conditions.
5. Closing: check whether the customer needs anything else and close courteously.
7.3 Special Situations
Out of stock: explain that the product is temporarily unavailable and suggest similar available options. Never confirm availability without checking current stock.
Discontinued product: explain that the product is no longer part of the catalog and offer equivalent or successor models.
Expired promotion: check whether it is active in the system. If it has expired, explain this transparently and provide the current price. Never promise a discount that is no longer valid.
Complaint: listen empathetically, record the complaint and refer it to the responsible person. Response time: 24 business hours.

sections.title: Warranty
sections.text:
8. Warranty
8.1 Statutory Warranty
According to the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code, all products have a 90-calendar-day statutory warranty against manufacturing defects, starting when the customer receives the product.
8.2 Manufacturer Warranty
In addition to the statutory warranty, most manufacturers offer their own warranty ranging from 6 months to 2 years. Specific periods and conditions are detailed in the warranty certificate supplied with each product.
8.3 Warranty Exclusions
Normal wear of components such as frets, strings, felts and wind instrument reeds.
Damage caused by misuse, falls or exposure to extreme weather conditions.
Modifications or repairs by unauthorized third parties.
Cosmetic damage that does not affect the instrument's functionality.

sections.title: Privacy and Data Protection
sections.text:
9. Privacy and Data Protection
The store follows Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).
Personal data collected during support, including name, phone number, email and address, are used exclusively for:
Processing and delivering orders.
Communicating order status and tracking information.
Sending promotions and news with the customer's explicit consent.
Meeting legal and tax obligations.
Customer data are not shared with third parties for marketing. Customers may request deletion of their data at any time through WhatsApp or email.

sections.title: Final Provisions
sections.text:
10. Final Provisions
This internal manual is a reference for all support staff, including the virtual assistant. Its policies may be updated periodically.
If a policy's application is unclear, the support representative must consult management before giving information to the customer.
The goal is transparency, accuracy and the best possible customer experience.
